channel.title: Benin - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Benin, every source cited.

item.title: Benin adopts new road safety law
item.description: New rules require certified helmets, registration, and safety equipment, impacting household budgets.

item.title: Benin concludes local consumption month with awards
item.description: The seventh edition of the 'Consommons Local' month ended with prizes for creative content and product promotion.

item.title: Benin minister opens African electricity finance summit
item.description: Think tanks debated regional electricity markets, consumer protection, and debt constraints on October 29.

item.title: Benin journalists trained on maternal health reporting
item.description: The Cerrhud and health ministry aim to improve media coverage of reproductive health issues.

item.title: Benin priest dies during All Saints' Day mass
item.description: Father Éric Ahissou, 48, died on November 1, 2026, while leading a service in Cotonou.
